core_fact: Makar Sankranti is called Magh Bihu (Bhogali Bihu) in Assam; Maghi in Punjab, Uttarayan in Gujarat, Khichdi in UP/Bihar.

statements.label: opt1

statements.label: opt2

statements.true_fact: Uttarayan is Gujarat's name.

statements.label: opt3
statements.text: In Assam, Makar Sankranti is celebrated as Kicheri.
statements.true_fact: Khichdi is the UP/Bihar name.

statements.label: opt4
statements.text: In Assam, Makar Sankranti is celebrated as Magh Bihu.

reconstruction.correct_statement: Makar Sankranti is Magh Bihu in Assam.
reconstruction.transformation: Other States' names offered.
reconstruction.why: Bihu = Assamese festival cycle (Rongali, Kongali, Bhogali/Magh).
reconstruction.micro_topic_rule: Sankranti names: Pongal (TN), Lohri/Maghi (Punjab), Uttarayan (Gujarat), Magh Bihu (Assam).
